page.notes: The left-margin note is set in italic and split across two lines ("Commo-" / "litas fum."); read as "Commoditas sum.", uncertain in its first word. The long s in the note is read as a plain s. "potissimúm" carries an accent as printed. The catchword "tari" sits at the right below the last line. A decorative mark appears in "complures in" and is not a reference mark, so it is not transcribed. Faint ink spots on the left and the Google watermark at the lower right are not printed text and are omitted.
